title: Under Construction
story: Before websites were finished, they announced their becoming. This sign made incompleteness feel like a destination.

title: The Guestbook
story: A public margin where strangers left names, URLs, compliments, and proof that somebody had arrived.

title: Hit Counter No. 000042
story: A tiny mechanical audience. Every visit turned the private homepage into a measurable place.

title: Cursor Trail
story: The cursor stopped being neutral and began leaving evidence: stars, glitter, comets, tiny witnesses.

title: MIDI Welcome Music
story: A page could sing before it could explain itself. Usually without asking permission first.

title: Dithered Sky
story: A handful of colors, carefully alternated, could imply an entire impossible gradient over a 28.8k modem.

title: A Very Small Web Ring
story: Previous. Random. Next. Websites held hands before platforms decided what should follow what.
